title: Cholesterol
body:
LIPITOR (and other statin drugs): http://www.scientificamerican.com/article/its-not-dementia-
its-your-heart-medication/ Statins like Lipitor cause memory problems. Learn about adverse
side effects. CoQ10 recommended as a supplement. http://www.mayoclinic.org/diseases-
conditions/high-blood-cholesterol/in-depth/statin-side-effects/art-20046013
The below on page 15 is the result of the clinical trial. 3% of the placebo group had a heart
attack and 2% of the Lipitor group, only a 1% benefit after 3 ½ years!
https://www.accessdata.fda.gov/drugsatfda_docs/label/2009/020702s056lbl.pdf
http://www.mayoclinic.org/diseases-conditions/high-blood-cholesterol/in-depth/statin-side-
effects/art-20046013 “The most common statin side effect is muscle pain. You may feel this
pain as a soreness, tiredness or weakness in your muscles. The pain can be a mild

discomfort, or it can be severe enough to make your daily activities difficult. For example, you
might find climbing stairs or walking to be uncomfortable or tiring.”
http://articles.mercola.com/sites/articles/archive/2011/06/22/new-study-show-using-statins-
actually-worsens-your-heart-function.aspx “Take this study in Clinical Cardiology. It found that
heart muscle function was "significantly better" in the control group than in those taking statin
drugs!” “Required labeling in Canada, however, clearly warns of CoQ10 depletion and even
notes that this nutrient deficiency "could lead to impaired cardiac function in patients with
borderline congestive heart failure."
http://articles.mercola.com/sites/articles/archive/2014/04/14/vitamin-d-cholesterol-levels.aspx
“Cholesterol sulfate is produced in large amounts in your skin when it is exposed to sunshine.
When you are deficient in cholesterol sulfate from lack of sun exposure, your body employs
another mechanism to increase it, as it is essential for optimal heart and brain function.” But
this produces the bad cholesterol.
I get much less sunshine than when I was young. I now get regular exposure to UVB which
produces good cholesterol. The UVB lamp is available at
https://www.sciencelighting.com/sankyo-denki-g15t8e-uvb-linear-lamp/ After receiving the
lamp, go to Home Depot and get a fixture to make sure that it is the right size for the bulb. A
T8 size bulb is about 18 inches, but the T8 fixtures were listed at 36 inches.
https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/UV-B_lamps “This low dosage does not increase the risk of skin
cancer and UV-B phototherapy remains a very safe treatment.”
